what: Red/green evidence for the verifier fixes V1-V3 (2026-11-02). 'before' is this study as the family sync left it (blobs.frag with safeDirection() on the transformed vectors, study.json with the empty 'behind' fallback, eight presets); 'after' is the delivered state. WebGL2 (SwiftShader) preview and plain Python only, not TouchDesigner.

V2_normals_at_scale.draw: One sphere (Count 1, Radius 0.6, Spread 0, Stretch 0, Ripple 0, Droplets 0), Prism Clear at t = 3 s, UV-ramp backdrop, blobs_geo scaled by s with camera distance 5 s, near 0.1 s, far 100 s and Object size s; each stage compared with s = 1 on every glass pixel (largest per-channel difference).
V2_normals_at_scale.note: Before the fix, at s = 20,000, 19,638 of the 43,020 normal-stage pixels read exactly +Y (0.5, 1, 0.5); the rest are +Y laid back into the view plane by faceCamera(). The thickness stage itself cannot be compared at that scale: it shows chord x 0.5 in scene units, which the 1024 output cap clips.

V1_twelve_presets.before: 8 presets: both tests fail on the count.
V1_twelve_presets.after: 12 presets; closest pair at t = 3 s: Checker 13.27/255 (sapphire_drops, oil_slick), Type 12.91/255 (sapphire_drops, oil_slick); threshold 10/255.
